verses.text: After Yahweh had given Israel peace from the enemies around them for a long time, Joshua was old and had many years on him. 🕊️
He called in all Israel—the elders, family leaders, judges, and officers—and told them, ‘I’m old now, and I’ve got plenty of years behind me. 🗣️
‘You saw everything Yahweh your God did to those nations for your sake. It was Yahweh your God who fought for you. ⚔️
‘Look, I’ve assigned you the nations that still remain as an inheritance for your tribes—from the Jordan all the way to the Great Sea in the west, along with the nations I already wiped out. 🗺️
‘Yahweh your God will push those nations out ahead of you and drive them away. You’ll take possession of their land, just as Yahweh your God promised. 🛡️
‘So be very brave: follow and do everything written in Moses’ law book. Don’t drift from it to the right or left. 📜
‘Don’t blend in with the nations still living among you. Don’t even mention the names of their gods, swear by them, serve them, or bow down to them. ⚠️
‘Stay close to Yahweh your God, just as you’ve done up to this day. 🤝
‘Yahweh drove powerful, strong nations out ahead of you. And to this day, no one has been able to stand against you. 💪
‘One of you can chase a thousand, because Yahweh your God is fighting for you, just as he promised. ⚔️
‘So watch yourselves carefully: love Yahweh your God. ❤️
‘But if you turn back, cling to the nations still living among you, marry into them, and they marry into your families, ⚠️

‘know for sure Yahweh your God won’t keep driving them out. They’ll become a trap and a snare for you, a whip at your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you’re gone from this good land Yahweh your God gave you. 🌵
‘Look, today I’m going the way everyone on earth goes. Deep down, you know not one good promise Yahweh your God made to you has failed. Every one came true. ✅
‘Just as all the good things Yahweh your God promised came to you, Yahweh will also bring every disaster on you, until you’re gone from this good land he gave you, ⚠️
‘if you break Yahweh your God’s covenant and go serve and bow down to other gods. Then Yahweh’s anger will flare against you, and you’ll quickly disappear from the good land he gave you.’’ 🔥
